steps.text: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook angel hair pasta in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, 4 to 5 minutes. Drain well.
Return pasta to the pot. Pour in spaghetti sauce and mix thoroughly until reheated.
Place taco shells onto a microwave-safe plate, then fan out into a circular shape so the edges of the taco shells overlap slightly. Microwave on high until warm and crisp, 30 to 45 seconds.
Spoon pasta mixture into warm taco shells. Sprinkle about 1 teaspoon Parmesan cheese onto each taco.

raw_recipe.headline: Spaghetti Tacos
raw_recipe.description: These fun spaghetti tacos were inspired by an episode of a popular kids’ comedy TV show. Just load spaghetti onto crispy taco shells and top with cheese!

review.reviewBody: I made these after my daughter wanted them (because of the TV show), but the entire family enjoyed them. We've made them several times. There is something so tasty about the flavor of the corn taco shell and the spaghetti together. The contrast of textures is very nice, too.

Slight modification make INCREDIBLE flavor improvement. When you're simmering the spaghetti sauce, mix a packet of Old El Paso taco seasoning with water according to packet directions. Add the taco seasoning to the spaghetti sauce. Simmer for 20 minutes on low so the flavors will blend. Add browned groud beef if you wish. This significantly changes the flavor and is deeeelish! You'll love it!

my daughter requested these kind of as a joke. so i made them as kind of a joke. we were all a little surprised at how good they were!! i added a pound of ground turkey, about 2 Tbls each cumin and chili powder to kick up the flavor. warmed the shells a little, filled them with mixture, topped with a sprinkling of oregano, parmesan cheese, and mozzerella. then put them back in the oven for a couple minutes. the fam went back for seconds!!

I made these for my son, (he had seen it on a t.v. show) and lo and behold, these tacos were GREAT!! I wanted it to be alittle more filling, so what I did was cook a pound and a half of hamburger meat, add a pound of tomatoes, diced,and two cans of tomato sauce. Cook these all together for about 30 minutes. 
I also chopped half a head of Iceburg lettuce, also chopped a few more tomatoes, half a bunch of Cilentro and some HOT peppers for me. I added the speghetti in the taco shells, then put the meat sauce on top of the speghetti, THEN added the lettuce, tomato and cilentro. These were SO good that several neighbors (3) come over whenever they know I'm cooking these tacos.
Most importantly, my son KNOWS he has to eat the tomato, cillentro and lettuce BEFORE he can get to the meat and spaghetti. These tacos are messy to eat, but really, they're SO good!!!

My kids LOVED this idea from watching the show also... I tweaked the recipe though. My kids love ground beef so I browned 1lb of Ground Beef, drained it, added one small can of Goya Tomato Sauce (the one with the green label that has cilantro in it), 1 pk taco seasoning, 1/3 cup of water. I combined it all with the cooked pasta. It was a hit at my house...even my boyfriend liked it.

My Daughter wanted spaghetti tacos after she saw Carly & Sam make it. We put taco seasoning in the ground beef. then added the spaghetti sauce, and sharp cheddar cheese. EVERYONE LOVED IT, even the grown ups :) My daughter has officially made this a famil dinner.

After being asked several times to make spaghetti tacos I have in. I am giving this recipe 5 stars because I did not make the spaghetti as described in the recipe. I thought it would be better with a southwestern style spaghetti. So I added red and black beans (drained and rinsed) along with corn (drained) and some cumin (1 teaspoon) into my regular classic style sauce made with half ground beef and half ground sausage to equal one pound, and from a kids perspective it was awesome, from an adults perspective it was okay. Was worth the try. I added a picture.

Have have made these for my kids too. Pretty much for the same reasons.... The TV show. I sprinkled the taco shells with garlic powder before I baked them. Then sprinkled parm cheese on top. I think I liked it more than the kids.

I have followed this recipe exactly in the cooking class. Students loved it. This year I changed from the angelhair to spaghetti squash. Students loved it even more!!! Saved a ton on calories and fat. I also use sugar-free spaghetti sauce (Hunt's) for the sauce. TERRIFIC!!!
yes i made this my family loved it it was very easy to make i bake the corn chips at 350° for 8 minutes

I cooked this last night for my iCarly loving daughter and she was thrilled! We added about 1/2 lb of ground beef and sprinkled parmesan cheese on top. Served them with salad and it was a meal that the whole family LOVED!

This doesn't quite work for me. I love spaghetti on toast and made into sandwiches, and while I like the crispy texture the corn tortilla adds to this, the italian spaghetti and parmesan aren't working with the corn tortilla. This probably would be much better in a flour tortilla as a burrito. This was not very good, but I also don't like spaghettios, canned pasta, or other kid favorites, so possibly it's simply my adult taste buds. I didn't care for it, but it wasn't bad. I did finish my portion. I'd give this 2.5 stars.
I added shredded cheddar cheese because that’s what I had and it melted from the hot sauce. Was delicious!
my family has been making these for years as a result of me and my older sister asking our parents to as kids because of icarly, absolutely love them 10/10

I'm not sure what exactly I was hoping for when I made these, but they were exactly what they said they were... Spaghetti Tacos. I usually love texture variances like this in a dish however, these were just not great.

As a kid who grew up watching iCarly, I wanted them so bad but my mom wouldn't make them so me and my friend made them at her house. All I can say is Spencer had the right idea when he took leftovers and put it in a taco shell! I totally forgot about them and can proudly say they are kid friendly!
I want to make it again after making one change of not microwaving the taco shells but everything's GREAT! I'd recommend it. One great idea! Do it!
